statements.notes:
D-Ribose is a five carbon sugar that acts as a source of cellular energy for the synthesis of ATP. Creatine is converted to creatine phosphate in the body, helping to fuel skeletal muscles and providing support for immediate energy production during high-intensity workouts. Creatine and Ribose have been shown to support healthy blood flow and mental acuity, while Creatine supports muscular endurance and strength especially during periods
of intense exercise and training. Creatine is also beneficial in stimulating cells necessary for muscular growth during training while Ribose aids in the removal of free radicals from the body. Both D-Ribose and Creatine are naturally occurring substances in the body, that jointly aid in optimizing results.*
*These statements have not been evaluated by the Food and Drug Administration. This product is not intended to diagnose, treat, cure or prevent any disease.
